version_binding: Sites version 13/source commit matches recorded prior deployment mapping to runtime 3738c730. Current repo runtime matches that commit. Historical deployment mapping reused; no fresh hosted asset-by-asset readback.
method: Single-owner heuristic and interaction audit; no independent reviewer or human comprehension study.

cases.name: Guest entry
cases.expected: Reach local Home without auth
cases.observed: Guest Home with Saved locally, existing groups and one expense.

cases.name: Guest Home reload
steps: Wait for Home to finish loading
cases.expected: Guest session and saved business records remain
cases.observed: Guest Home returned with same two groups and one expense.

cases.name: Guest invite permission boundary
cases.expected: Explain account prerequisite before invitation
cases.observed: Ready to share? Create your ChopDot account to invite people. Everything you have done stays. No invitation sent.

cases.name: Boundary cancellation and reopen
cases.expected: Return to same saved guest Home and allow retry
cases.observed: Same groups and expense retained; account boundary reopened.

cases.name: Create-account form
cases.expected: Make the local prototype completion method clear
cases.observed: Email form says We will send you a sign-in code; local mock instructions hidden.

cases.name: Empty email validation
cases.expected: Prevent progression and identify missing input
cases.observed: Native Please fill out this field prompt focused Email. No screenshot of transient native validation saved.

cases.name: Synthetic email challenge
cases.expected: Truthfully describe simulated external capability and how to continue
cases.observed: Check your email; Sent to clarity-j01@example.com; no delivery or visible fixture-code instructions.

cases.name: Invalid code
cases.expected: Stay on code entry with an inline error
cases.observed: That code does not match. Try again.

cases.name: Change email
cases.expected: Return to email form and retain entered address
cases.observed: Email form returned with populated field (AX redacted); resending without changing it produced the same destination.

cases.name: Reload during conversion
cases.expected: Preserve safe destination/effort or explain intentional restart
cases.observed: Guest Home and business records survive; code entry and invite intent disappear without restart explanation. No auth proof should be persisted merely to fix this.

cases.name: Back during conversion
cases.expected: Return to guest boundary/Home or the accepted guest-first entry
cases.observed: Older marketing welcome with only email and wallet options; no guest or Home escape. Reload required to get back to guest Home.

cases.name: Wallet alternative
cases.expected: Explain simulated approval and provide the defined local outcome path
cases.observed: Check your wallet. Approve the sign-in request there. Hidden local outcome controls; no real wallet request.

cases.name: Wallet pending/cancel
cases.expected: Never turn pending into success; cancellation remains available
cases.observed: Still waiting for your wallet. Cancel returned to wallet selector; email alternative returned to email.

cases.name: New-person ready with documented fixture
cases.expected: Model permits a local verified ready state without automatic join/payment
cases.observed: Signed in / You are ready / Open ChopDot. No final conversion committed. Completion depended on source knowledge unavailable in the normal form.

cases.name: Demo guide disclosure
cases.expected: Disclose simulations and local storage
cases.observed: Guide says one tab, browser-local work, simulated accounts/external results and no funds; does not provide email-code instructions. Transcript in tool record, captured screenshot unavailable.

cases.name: Second-tab writer boundary
steps: Open a second integrated tab while prior tab holds writer lock
cases.expected: Refuse concurrent writes with actionable recovery
cases.observed: Close other tab, then reload; data has not changed. Releasing prior tab via about:blank allowed testing. Initial observation was not saved as a screenshot.

cases.name: Real account-conversion commit
cases.expected: Guest business records and identity survive final conversion
cases.observed: Intentionally not executed against existing saved audit records; ready-state check is not integrated completion.

cases.name: Returning Sign in
cases.expected: Returning identity and destination clear
cases.observed: Not executed before browser navigation policy blocked later actions. Covered model behavior separately, not rendered UX.

cases.name: Contextual invite and counterpart
cases.expected: Preserve inviter/group/participant context and avoid automatic membership
cases.observed: Not executed; counterpart UX and integrated participant link remain unassessed.

cases.name: Offline/expired/declined/unknown recovery UI
cases.expected: Every required recovery screen has a truthful next step
cases.observed: Model checks passed; rendered fixture recovery screens were not executed. Do not substitute model PASS for UI PASS.

cases.name: Canonical viewport and keyboard comparison
steps: Compare source and integrated states at established viewports
cases.expected: Retain approved hierarchy with accessible controls
cases.observed: 1363x936 cloud viewport only; observed embedded CSS 428x878. No canonical 393x852/430x890 comparison or keyboard-only qualification.

cases.name: Fresh-storage first use
steps: Use a genuinely isolated new browser context
cases.expected: Start empty without changing existing saved work
cases.observed: Local package built, but cloud browser cannot reach 127.0.0.1:4187 (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED). Hosted tabs share storage; no reset performed.

source_tests.scope: Local model guards, no rendered UX
Local subject/request/identity binding, no real authentication

limitations: Original browser business records were not reset, removed or converted. Guest entry/test actor selection changed local entry state only.

Prior Audit Alex test actor was changed to You to enter J01. Original tab was placed on about:blank to release writer lock; restoration later could not be verified because browser policy rejected the cleanup call. Saved original payment URL is unchanged; actor may remain You.
Two guide-link actions and the later diagnostics/restore call were rejected by browser URL policy. No circumvention attempted. These are environment blocks, not proven app broken-link findings.
Some AX/image pairs lagged; rejected screenshots are listed explicitly.
No repo-wide CI, hosted Actions, canonical screenshot certification, real emails, wallets, funds, signing, independent review or user study executed.
Other 27 journeys and prior 12 findings are not cleared by this audit.
